about_the_game:
Exit Plan b is a roguelite arcade action-puzzler where every run drops you into a procedurally generated maze packed with danger, loot, and tight, satisfying movement.

Each level begins with a freshly generated maze. Unforgiving, unchanging, and unique to your run. Your goal: collect enough points to spawn the exit and escape. But there's a cost. Activating skills consumes gems, and reckless use can cut a run short. Every step is permanent, every choice matters. Learn it. Master it. Survive it.

Key features:

  • Arcade Core, Modern Edge: Fast-paced, no-nonsense action in the spirit of retro classics.

  • Roguelite Progression: Procedurally generated levels, randomized loot, and skill-based upgrades. Fresh runs and high stakes.

  • Risk-Reward Gameplay: Spend gems to use powerful skills - but every gem used is one less earned. Survival is strategy.

  • Snappy Controls, Instant Restarts: Precision movement and zero downtime keep the action flowing.

Escape Plan b is a love letter to arcade classics, supercharged with roguelite flavor. It's about going in blind, getting better every time, and chasing that perfect run.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 710
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: Exit Plan b is a fast-paced action-puzzle roguelite where you explore intricate mazes, collect coins, evade and outsmart relentless enemies, and gather gems and points to unlock powerful new skills and progress through increasingly challenging levels.
